# Avise

> Deal flow software, institutional CRM, and AI-powered deal analysis for search funds, independent sponsors, and emerging private equity managers.

Avise replaces the manual, spreadsheet-driven workflow PE firms use to source deals, run due diligence, and manage relationships — with an AI system that reads documents, extracts financials, flags risks, and writes investment memos.

## Product

- [Pricing](/pricing): Plans for boutique, mid-market, and enterprise PE firms.
- [Security & Trust](/security): Encryption, tenant isolation, sub-processors, compliance roadmap.
- [Documentation](/documentation): Setup guides and feature walkthroughs.
- [Help Center](/help-center): FAQs on account setup, deal management, AI features, billing.
